name: thepapers-niw
description: U.S. EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) skills for DIY self-petitioners and immigration professionals. Includes niw-evaluate: pre-filing case evaluation under the current USCIS adjudication standard, with Dhanasar three-prong analysis, preponderance verdict floors, citation discipline, and an achievable case ceiling for prospective applicants. Legal substance is published in knowledge/ and distilled from the complete public pool of 1,040 AAO non-precedent NIW decisions issued 2025-01 through 2026-06. Future skills will cover endeavor-statement drafting, national-importance evidence research, recommendation letters, petition letter drafting, pre-filing package review, and RFE/NOID response.
displayName: NIW Skills by The Papers Company
